memory_candidates.content: When a lint script must enumerate 'all agents' in this repo, a bare `**/agents/*.md` path glob is wrong: three files match it that are not dispatchable subagents -- `core/agents/README.md` and the two `lean/context/project/lean4/agents/lean-{research,implementation}-flow.md` reference docs, none of which has a frontmatter block. The correct detector gates on frontmatter presence (first line `---`) plus a `name:` key, which yields 75 dispatchable agents out of 78 glob matches. Write this detector once as a reusable shell function; every future agent-wide check (required body sections, terminal-metadata presence, frontmatter key validity) needs the same gate and will otherwise re-derive it incorrectly.
